text: Residents have reached out to our office with concerns about pedestrian safety at the intersection of Norwood Road and Benlamond Avenue/Glen Oak Drive. Concerns raised include inconsistent yielding behaviour by drivers. Residents have also reported difficulty safely crossing, particularly during peak travel periods, as well as several near-miss incidents involving both pedestrians and vehicles. As part of safety improvements at this intersection, Transportation Services recommends the implementation of all-way stop control at this intersection.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized a compulsory stop control for southbound traffic on Norwood Road and Benlamond Avenue/Glen Oak Drive.
